Use these only once your lobes are fully settled at the size. Apply a little oil or balm to the lobe, insert the plug sideways or fold it in, ease it through, and settle the flare behind the ear. Wait 4-6 weeks between sizes and never force a stretch; some pressure is normal, but stop if it hurts.

Easy to clean. Wear at your current size; these are not for sizing up.

What size should I order?

Order the BodyJ4You 18PC Stone Plug Set in the gauge your lobes are already at. The flare on each side is one size larger, for example an 8G (3.2mm) plug has a 6G (4mm) flare.

The BodyJ4You 18PC Stone Plug Set contains one pair each of amethyst, agate, amber, goldstone, turquoise, white agate, petalite, sodalite and bloodstone.

Can I use these to stretch?

No. The BodyJ4You 18PC Stone Plug Set is double flared, so wear it only once your lobes are fully settled at that size.

How do I put in double flare plugs?

Apply a little oil or balm, fold or turn the BodyJ4You 18PC Stone Plug Set plug sideways, ease it through and settle the back flare behind the ear.

Do they need O-rings?

No. The BodyJ4You 18PC Stone Plug Set plugs have a flare on both sides that holds them in place.
